## Context
The PRD requires a new greeting package. This ADR decides the package structure and API shape.

## Decision
Create internal/greeting package with a single Hello function. The function takes an optional name parameter. If no name is provided, it defaults to "World".

## Alternatives Considered
Option A: Add greeting to existing labels package. Rejected because greeting is a separate concern.
Option B: Use a third-party library. Rejected for such a simple utility.

## Evidence
Based on PRD requirement REQ-001 and REQ-002. The existing codebase uses simple packages without external dependencies.

## Consequences
- New package internal/greeting with greeting.go and greeting_test.go
- No changes to existing packages
- Zero external dependencies

## Compatibility and Migration
No migration needed. This is a new package with no existing consumers.

## TDD Obligations
TDD-ADR-001: Unit test for Hello() with default name
TDD-ADR-002: Unit test for Hello("World") returns personalized greeting

## Rollback
Delete internal/greeting directory. No other packages are affected.

## Context
REQ-002 specifies personalized greetings. This ADR defines the function signature.

## Decision
Hello(name string) string returns "Hello, " + name + "!".

## Alternatives Considered
Option A: Variadic parameter. Rejected for simplicity.
Option B: Struct-based greeting. Rejected as over-engineered.

## Evidence
Based on PRD REQ-002 and standard Go conventions.

## Consequences
Simple string signature, easy to test, zero allocations.

## Compatibility and Migration
No migration needed.

## TDD Obligations
TDD-ADR-002: Unit test for personalized greeting

## Rollback
Remove the name parameter if not needed.

- None
